summary: The latest branch is oodialog-qt6-v0.8, renderer v0.8.0, based on and tested against oodialog-wasm 2423db8 (v0.17.0). All 45 of the suite's tests pass, both offscreen and on an X server (Xvfb with Qt's xcb platform, as a desktop runs it). New in v0.8.0: the month calendar (v0.16.0: SimpleMonthCalendar, PaidHolidays), ResizingAdmin (v0.17.0: basicResize, augmentedResize, gbStationary) and the editable combo's edit (v0.17.0: dropDownComboBox). Since v0.8.0 a program that ends before its steps are done fails; dropDownComboBox had passed that way once before the check existed. The suite is the browser harness's tests, with their .steps and .expect files, plus the three programs the ooDialog Designer generates (Calculator, Contacts, Gadgets; see sphere oodialog-designer), used unchanged as a contract test. Every one of upstream's sample programs was also started with nothing clicked: against v0.17.0, 81 of 122 programs showed their dialog (77 against v0.15.0, 75 against v0.14.0, 73 against v0.13.1). All 37 errors were in oodWeb.cls's scope; none was in the renderer: winsystm.cls 19, resource reader not set 8, ooDialog native functions oodWeb does not have yet 7, other 3. Earlier branches and their oodialog-wasm bases: v0.2 2c861d8, v0.3 23d57b2, v0.4 155e1b0, v0.5 1d89981, v0.6 0e0e744, v0.7 fc16dfb.
